name: Zhulis Mods Manager
description: Install and update Zhulis mods straight from GitHub releases

issues.info: Report bugs on GitHub or in the Discord server

check-on-startup.name: Check for updates on startup
check-on-startup.description: Fetch the latest GitHub releases of Zhulis mods when the game starts.

periodic-check.name: Check while playing
periodic-check.description: Look for new releases every 30 minutes and show a notification for the ones that came out since.

include-prereleases.name: Include pre-releases
include-prereleases.description: Offer GitHub pre-releases too, not only stable releases.

registry-url.name: Registry URL
registry-url.description: JSON list of tracked mods. A built-in list is used if it can't be fetched.
